title: Cyberattack on Fireworks AI allowed hackers to access Notion customers’ chat transcripts
lede: An attacker reached a Fireworks AI development system through its cloud provider and took customer data, including chat transcripts from Notion AI users of the Insights feature.

points: Fireworks says billing information and some datasets were stolen; customers on its platform include Harvey and Cursor.
Notion says around 1% of its customers were affected and it cut all connections to Fireworks on November 3.
The stolen transcripts contain model inputs and outputs, though much of it could not be tied to a specific customer.
Fireworks believes the attackers want to resell stolen LLM access to unauthorized buyers.
It is the second Fireworks breach in two months, after an incident in October.

sections.text: Prompts and outputs sent through a hosted inference provider sit in that provider's systems, so a breach there exposes your users even when your own stack is untouched.
